intro.title: View transitions (View Transitions API)
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple image gallery that smoothly transitions between images when you click on them. You will learn the core concept of the View Transitions API, which allows you to create animated transitions between different states of the DOM. The main technologies involved are CSS for styling and the JavaScript View Transitions API to trigger and control the animations. This beginner-friendly lesson will show you how to apply a basic view transition to make your web pages feel more dynamic and polished.
intro.usecase: View Transitions API creates smooth, polished state changes that users encounter daily in modern web applications. Developers implement these transitions in dashboard interfaces when switching between data views, in e-commerce sites during product image galleries or filtering operations, and in single-page applications for seamless route changes. This API helps build professional interfaces like admin panels where modals appear/disappear smoothly, or content management systems where editors preview changes without jarring jumps. Mastering view transitions allows you to create the fluid, app-like experiences that today's users expect from premium web products.
